from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import json

ROOT=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
TASK="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
envp=ROOT/"model_results"/(TASK+".json")

def emit(payload):
    print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_ASTRA_PREBUILD")
    print("ERROR="+json.dumps(payload,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(1)

if not envp.is_file():
    emit({"state":"PENDING","reason":"MODEL_RESULT_MISSING"})

env=json.loads(envp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
cp=(ROOT/str(env.get("checkpoint",""))).resolve()
runs=(ROOT/"models/runs").resolve()
try:
    cp.relative_to(runs)
except ValueError:
    emit({"state":"INVALID","reason":"CHECKPOINT_OUTSIDE_RUNTIME"})

need={}
for name in ("TASK.json","WORKER.json","COMPLETE.json","events.jsonl"):
    p=cp/name
    if not p.is_file():
        emit({"state":"PENDING","reason":"CHECKPOINT_FILE_MISSING","file":name})
    need[name]=p

task=json.loads(need["TASK.json"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
worker=json.loads(need["WORKER.json"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
complete=json.loads(need["COMPLETE.json"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
final=complete.get("final")
try:
    review=json.loads(final) if isinstance(final,str) else final
except Exception:
    emit({"state":"INVALID","reason":"FINAL_NOT_JSON"})

if not isinstance(review,dict):
    emit({"state":"INVALID","reason":"REVIEW_NOT_OBJECT"})

checks={
 "task_id":task.get("task_id")==TASK,
 "phase":task.get("phase")=="ASTRA_PREBUILD",
 "policy":task.get("model_policy")=="ASTRA_EXACT",
 "worker_model":worker.get("model")=="gpt-6-astra",
 "selected_slug":(worker.get("model_selection") or {}).get("selected_slug")=="gpt-6-astra",
 "decision":review.get("decision") in {"APPROVE","REJECT","REVISE"},
 "candidate":review.get("candidate_id")=="AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d",
 "phase_result":review.get("phase")=="PREBUILD",
}
bad=sorted(k for k,v in checks.items() if not v)
if bad:
    emit({"state":"INVALID","reason":"CHECK_FAILED","bad":bad})

emit({
 "state":"COMPLETE",
 "decision":review.get("decision"),
 "model":worker.get("model"),
 "selected_slug":(worker.get("model_selection") or {}).get("selected_slug"),
 "finding":str(review.get("finding") or "")[:120],
 "next_action":str(review.get("next_action") or "")[:120]
})
